visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long wavy dark hair is seen in a medium shot, sitting on a light-colored floor indoors. She wears a beige strapless top and dark pants, holding a light blue smartphone. Beside her, a young child with a shaved head and a blue striped shirt leans forward, eyes fixed on the screen. The background is a clean, modern room with a wooden cabinet and a minimalist TV displaying a pink-hued landscape. (2) The scene cuts to a video clip of a male firefighter in a navy blue and yellow uniform performing a rescue maneuver. He is on a concrete garage floor next to several red and white fire trucks. He rolls a colleague onto his back and prepares to lift him. A text box with white background and black text appears in the lower-right corner. (3) Returning to the living room, the woman stands up and attempts to flip a man lying on his back on the rug. The man is wearing dark clothing. She grips his arm and tries to roll him over her back. Her movements are strained and uncoordinated. In the background, the TV continues to show the pink-toned beach imagery. (4) A close-up shot focuses on the young child with the shaved head. He has a wide-eyed, dramatic expression, staring intensely toward the camera or the action off-screen. His face is illuminated by soft indoor lighting, and he appears to be imitating the intensity of the rescue situation. (5) The camera angle shifts to a low perspective on the floor. The woman and man are entangled in a struggle to complete the carry. Her legs kick into the air as she tries to gain leverage. An older child wearing a green Minecraft-themed T-shirt jumps into the frame from the right, landing on the pile of people. (6) The scene becomes a montage of chaotic rolling on the patterned rug. The woman, man, and two children are all moving together in a tangle of limbs. The woman is laughing, her head tossing back. The lighting is bright and even across the room, highlighting the domestic clutter of the ongoing game.
